subject: Emotions
title: Disgust and Politics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Disgust and Politics.

hook.text: People who react more strongly to gross images tend to vote conservative. The link is consistent.

buildup.text: Yoel Inbar's research found disgust sensitivity predicts opposition to immigration and social change.

discovery.text: The purity moral foundation—one of Haidt's six—maps directly onto political conservatism worldwide.

twist.text: Political ads exploit this. Showing dirty or decaying images before a policy question shifts opinions rightward.

climax.text: Your political views aren't just about reason. They're partly about how sensitive your disgust reflex is.

punchline.text: Your stomach votes before your brain does.

quiz.question: What does high disgust sensitivity predict politically?
